text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*...!
Is he still not finished?!
What a tough cookie...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……！
まだやっつけられないの！？
しぶといな～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I still feel a strong power from him!
Don't let your guard down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ強大な力を残してるみたい！
最後まで油断しないで！

text_block_list.name: Phantom Baron
text_block_list.text:
GRUOOOOGHHH!
Give her... GIVE HANA TO MEEEEEE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぉぉぉぉぉおお！！
ハナを、
ハナを返せぇぇぇえ！！

text_block_list.name: Phantom Baron
text_block_list.text:
I want her here! I need her to remember!
That is my only wiiiiish!
Why must you interfeeeere?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そばにいたい！！
　忘れられたくない！！
それだけなんだぁあああああ！！
なぜ邪魔をするぅぅぅぅう！！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
...!
No, you can't! Hana's still alive like us!
You've got to say bye-bye now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！！
ダメだよ！！
　ハナちゃんは生きてるんだもん！
きちんとさよならしなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Mimi's absolutely right!
Give it up and stop being selfish!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミの言う通りです！
いい加減
観念してください！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Stubborn guys like him only listen to brute force!
C'mon, guys! Mimi! Kyoka!
Let's end this once and for all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分からず屋は全力で分からせるしかないね！
行こうよ！
　ミミ、
キョウカ！
これでおしまいにしちゃおう！
